title: Spinner
lead: Indicate a loading status when fetching data by using the spinner component built with React and animated with Tailwind CSS based on multiple colors and sizes

prose.text:
The spinner component should be used to indicate a loading status of the content that you're fetching from your database and you can choose from multiple styles, colors, sizes, and animations based on React and Tailwind CSS.

Import the spinner component from Flowbite React to start using it in your project:

prose.title: Default spinner
prose.text: Use the default spinner element by adding the `<Spinner>` React component inside your code and integrate the `aria-label` attribute to allow screen readers parse the component for accessibility.

prose.title: Spinner colors
prose.text: Update the colors of the loading spinner by using the `color` React prop.

prose.title: Sizing options
prose.text: Make the size of the spinner smaller or larger by using the `size` prop. Choose from `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, or `xl`.

prose.title: Alignment
prose.text: Align the spinner to the left, center or right side of the page by using the utility classes from Tailwind CSS.

prose.title: Loading buttons
prose.text: Add the loading spinner inside a button to indicate fetching status directly inside form submission buttons.

prose.title: Theme
prose.text: To learn more about how to customize the appearance of components, please see the [Theme docs](/docs/customize/theme).
